The upper unit has no visible brand or model label.
To the right of the AC units is a large black metal cabinet with a front panel that has diagonal white stripes (photo 0).
Photo 1 shows the same cabinet with its front panel removed, revealing multiple shelves with copper tubing and metal grates, suggesting a drying or heating chamber.
The interior of the cabinet has a green base layer (photo 1).
The setup is outdoors, on a concrete surface, surrounded by banana trees and a fence.
The units and cabinet show signs of wear, dirt, and weathering.
No indoor unit or control panel is visible.
The seller claims the machine works like magic, is soft touch, easy to operate, and built with high quality materials.

While the brand 'SHARP' is visible on one unit, the overall device lacks clear identity and proof of function. A video and close-ups are needed to assess functionality and condition before pricing.
